notes: Redesign: the Live Link notification. The right-side badge is now a status disc (green check = whole chain up, orange ! = up but checks went stale, red X = a hop is down); the status text fits on one line; expanded, it shows how long the link has been stable or down, what each hop is doing, and in plain words what a break takes away. Everything else is exactly as in v3.9.12.
